gold.text: User-added categories can also generate random inspiration.
Users can edit existing categories.
Users can delete existing types
The webpage provides several preset categories.
Users can select preset categories to generate random inspiration.
Webpage supports continuous generation of inspiration
Users can collect the generated inspiration.
Users can view the inspiration they have saved from the collection list.
Users can view their browsing history of inspiration.
Users can revisit the generated inspiration records
Users can add categories themselves.
Webpages should not create duplicate categories with the same name.
The webpage prevents users from selecting two categories simultaneously for inspiration generation.
When a user deletes their inspiration log, the saved inspiration cannot be deleted.
The user was unable to successfully add a new category without entering a name.
Provide visual feedback when a new hint is successfully generated.
Provide visual feedback when a user successfully adds a new category.
Provide visual feedback when users modify or delete categories.
The webpage highlights the category selected by the user.
When users add or remove inspiration from their favorites, visual feedback is provided for the entries, and the information is displayed in the favorites list in real time.
The generated inspiration content must correspond to the selected category.
